shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && rg -n \"list_sessions|before cursor|Conversation list|VALIDATED_BY|validated by\" specs package.json src/transport/ws"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && sed -n '1,150p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({scripts:p.scripts,devDependencies:{prettier:p.devDependencies?.prettier,jest:p.devDependencies?.jest}},null,2))\" && rg -n \"repoint-spec|reanchor\" scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,210p' && nl -ba src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | sed -n '35,190p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\('(answers list_sessions|answers an empty session_list|accepts a bare list_sessions|accepts a complete before cursor|waits for an in-flight lookup|latest)\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && git status --short && git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,320p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && git commit -m "Validate conversation list cursor" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
